clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move across the country in March 1952 and the purchase of the apple orchard, within the year: June's homesickness and daily letters to her sister, Walter out in the trees from dark to dark with distance growing between them, Glen's fights at school and being sent home twice, Walter's cutoff from his brother Harlan over their father's land money, June keeping to her bed for weeks that winter, rows between Walter and June over money for new trees, and finally June joining the church choir in the fall with her anxiety easing and her functioning rising as her letters thinned out—all shifts of Walter's family in these months, with the move itself the opening event.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when a late frost took the whole crop and the bank called in the loan: Walter drinking heavily by June, conflict between Walter and Glen over who bore blame for the loan by July, Glen and Marian taking over the family's money and talks with the bank by November, Carl's asthma attacks worsening that winter, Nora beginning to wet the bed in April 1969, Ida's heart trouble found in May requiring her to stop working, and Walter stopping drinking by October and taking work pruning other men's trees—shifts in Walter's drinking and functioning, Glen's overfunctioning, Carl's symptom, and Nora's symptom all within these months around the loss of the orchard.

clusters.name: Glen's job lost at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975, within about a year: Glen out of work most of that year sitting in the truck in the yard for hours, loud fights between Glen and Marian at night over money, Marian taking a second job cleaning offices at night, Nora stopping eating properly and losing weight that summer, Nora keeping to her room and distancing from her mother, Walter drinking again after six years off it by December, and Nora eating again and making the track team by June 1976—shifts in Glen's functioning down, Glen and Marian's conflict, Marian's overfunctioning, Nora's symptom down and up, and Walter's symptom all in these months around Glen's loss of work.

clusters.name: Wilma moving into Nora and Hollis's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma selling her farm and moving into Nora and Hollis's house in January 1990, within about a year: Nora and Wilma clashing over the children's bedtimes and meals by April, Hollis working late and keeping out of the kitchen rows by May, Hollis taking his mother's side by May, Owen having tantrums at preschool by June, Wilma taking over Lily's care by August, Nora's eczema flaring on both hands by September, rows between Nora and Hollis most nights by November, and Nora's eczema clearing over the summer of 1991 once Wilma took a flat in town in June—shifts in Nora and Wilma's conflict, Hollis's distance from Nora and toward Wilma, Owen's symptom, Wilma's overfunctioning, and Nora's symptom all within these months around Wilma's move into the household.
